title: Sponsoring Piracy

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: What. The. Actual. FUCK?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What. The. Actual. FUCK?!

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: No, this is beyond wrong. This is borderline criminal. Nah, forget that... This is messing with someone's paycheck and you DON'T DO THAT!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, this is beyond wrong. This is borderline criminal. Nah, forget that... This is messing with someone's paycheck and you DON'T DO THAT!

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: You don't even understand. You'll never get what it's like to lose it all and be given this second opportunity to stake you claim, put your damn name in the Nets.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't even understand. You'll never get what it's like to lose it all and be given this second opportunity to stake you claim, put your damn name in the Nets.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: Corpsters put a vice tax on Hover Derby sponsors. Said only "violent degenerates would want to physically abuse their opponents in a way that should be illegal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Corpsters put a vice tax on Hover Derby sponsors. Said only "violent degenerates would want to physically abuse their opponents in a way that should be illegal.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: You do that. Meanwhile I'm here dealing with a lack of sponsors. You know how you play sports? People sponsor you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You do that. Meanwhile I'm here dealing with a lack of sponsors. You know how you play sports? People sponsor you!

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: Oh, look at that?! Someone understands basic economics. Remarkable that you have your own place.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, look at that?! Someone understands basic economics. Remarkable that you have your own place.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: I'd sign my fake teeth and give 'em to you. What do you have in mind?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd sign my fake teeth and give 'em to you. What do you have in mind?

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: Move past it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Move past it.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: Who? What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who? What?

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: And he wants to sponsor me to play Hover Derby? What's the catch?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And he wants to sponsor me to play Hover Derby? What's the catch?

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: And if they don't, I'll polish you a set of slides and you can play keeps in the next round. You ever broken a bone before? Eh, not that it matters. Alright, let's see how this plays out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And if they don't, I'll polish you a set of slides and you can play keeps in the next round. You ever broken a bone before? Eh, not that it matters. Alright, let's see how this plays out.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: Or at least seriously frowned upon. Like, what the fuck else are we supposed to do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Or at least seriously frowned upon. Like, what the fuck else are we supposed to do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is something wrong?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...I'm just gonna go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...I'm just gonna go.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Unless you're a bad employee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unless you're a bad employee.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm listening.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm listening.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I should leave you to it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I should leave you to it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I should leave you to it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I should leave you to it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: All ears... I guess.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All ears... I guess.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No sponsors means no Lims?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No sponsors means no Lims?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What if I could get you a sponsor?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What if I could get you a sponsor?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What if I could get you a sponsor?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What if I could get you a sponsor?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He's notorious. Cunning. Everything a sailor of these seas should be.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's notorious. Cunning. Everything a sailor of these seas should be.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He's notorious. Cunning. Everything a sailor of these seas should be.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He's notorious. Cunning. Everything a sailor of these seas should be.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He's a joke. Total washup wannabe pirate who was born much too late.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's a joke. Total washup wannabe pirate who was born much too late.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He's a joke. Total washup wannabe pirate who was born much too late.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He's a joke. Total washup wannabe pirate who was born much too late.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's disgusting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's disgusting.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Captain Taylor Hernz.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Captain Taylor Hernz.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You put his name on your jersey and the Lims will roll in.
